scope: two-treatment clean-only region-localization diagnostic for the residual RetinaNet INT8 gap
limitations: Historical checkpoint-selection evaluation partition, not a new confirmatory holdout.
One engine build per treatment; no seed or build-population inference.
No continuation gate is applied: region restriction localizes sensitivity rather than authorizing a robustness study.
Region-level AP changes are descriptive; they do not identify which individual layers are fragile.
A successful selective-precision result is baseline engineering evidence, not a new robustness method.
